column3: “The people of Ammon” is rendered “the Ammonites.”
“Covenant loyalty” is rendered “kindness,” and NASB supplies “some of.” NASB carries the sentence into verse 3.
“Leaders” is rendered “princes,” and the question is expanded with “Do you think that.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “it” and “then.”
“The gate” is rendered “the city,” and “open country” as “field.”
“The face of the battle” is rendered “the battle was set against him.”
“Become deliverance for me” is rendered “help me.”
“The good in His eyes” is rendered “what is good in His sight,” and NASB makes it a wish (“may the LORD do”).
“Returned from on” is rendered “returned from fighting against.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to deliver” is rendered “to help.”
